findings.question: Q3 SCIENCE (X1 inventory definition — the NG2 dead-form-envelope law must be unambiguous)
findings.evidence: plans/PLAN_crypto_ng3.md §5 X1: "pooled |rho| <= 0.20 vs the full crypto inventory"; the binding NG2 law as recorded is plans/PLAN_crypto_ng2.md line 21 "D2 measures pooled |rho| <= 0.20 vs the 29-shape panel + FOMC-form shadows" and HYPOTHESIS_LEDGER.md line 208: NG2 proposals "were CLEAN on the full 29-shape panel and all named controls (funding-level <0.021) — killed only by the dead-form envelope". §5 X2 names "OILEV-V2 and the NG2 dead-form shadow set" which arguably includes the 29-shape panel by reference, but the panel is never named explicitly in the plan text
findings.recommendation: One-line textual pin: X1's inventory must be declared to include the full 32-row FAMILY_FAILURES inventory AND the 29-shape panel AND the NG2 dead-form shadow set (the exact triad of the NG2 closing law), so no D2 lane can argue the 29-shape panel is outside "the full crypto inventory" and skip it. The dead-form envelope is the only class that killed proposals that were clean on everything else; ambiguity here is gate-shopping surface.

findings.question: Q5 CONVENTIONS (prewritten terminal outcomes incomplete vs the ng template)
findings.evidence: plans/PLAN_crypto_ng3.md §10 lists 6 outcomes: BLOCKED_SOURCE_OR_SCHEMA, BLOCKED_DATA_OR_SELECTION, BLOCKED_PRELAUNCH, REJECT_ALL, INCOMPLETE_NOT_PROMOTABLE, TECHABORT_PRESERVED. Both ng predecessors preregistered a survivor label absent here: plans/PLAN_crypto_ng1.md lines 68-71 and plans/PLAN_crypto_ng2.md line 28 include ONE_OR_MORE_STAGE_A_SURVIVORS_LOCKED_FOR_FUTURE_S1. Also §3 maps "any C1-C9 miss => BLOCKED_SOURCE" but leaves C10 (fold freeze) and C11 (reproducibility) misses without an explicit terminal mapping (BLOCKED_SOURCE_OR_SCHEMA plausibly covers C11 by its name; C10 is unmapped)
findings.recommendation: Add CRYPTO_NG3_ONE_OR_MORE_STAGE_A_SURVIVORS_LOCKED_FOR_FUTURE_S1 to §10 — §6 writes the expected modal terminal as a D2 kill, so a positive close is the one path with no preregistered name, which is exactly what prewritten outcomes exist to prevent. State explicitly that a C10 fold-freeze miss at P0 closes BLOCKED_SOURCE_OR_SCHEMA (or add it to the C1-C9 fail line).

findings.question: Q6 LICENSE (CC BY-NC cross-check leg lacks the binding P-18/P-25 demand)
findings.evidence: plans/PLAN_crypto_ng3.md §2 and §11 demote Coin Metrics Community (CC BY-NC 4.0) and DefiLlama (no surfaced license) to CROSS-CHECK only, zero scored weight, and cite license+PIT as the reasons — consistent in direction with the program's law. But research/wayfinder/LESSONS.md P-25 (2026-09-15, same-day law): entitlement has three independent layers and "permitted (terms compatible with the USE, not just the download)" binds non-scored use too; P-18: a ruling binds only when it lives at the exact bytes a machine gate reads; the critic's own kill-gate #10 (critic_report.md §5.10) demanded "CC BY-NC owner adjudication recorded at the enforcing bytes (P-18) BEFORE any scored consumption, or the cross-check leg is dropped". The plan records no owner adjudication and no drop rule for the cross-check leg
findings.recommendation: Bind the leg: either (a) pin the owner adjudication bytes (or its absence) before any CM/llama byte is consumed even as cross-check, with attribution recorded, or (b) predeclare the cross-check leg DROPPED at P0 unless/until the adjudication lands. Zero scored weight keeps it out of REFUSED territory (the plan never asserts the data is permissible, it demotes it) — but "we only look at it" is still a use under CC BY-NC inside a trading-research program, and P-25 says terms are read against the USE.

hunting_summary: Fresh-context adversarial audit; every input re-measured from bytes, nothing trusted from the plan. Q1 AUTHORITY: P-19 chain VERIFIED — LESSONS.md lines 587-599 carry the owner verbatim directive (generation ending <= 6 scored cells / <= 2 families opens ONE more full cycle from scratch); plans/CYCLE_REGISTRY.json CRYPTO-NG2 row is TERMINAL CRYPTO_NG2_BLOCKED_DATA_OR_SELECTION, budget used 0/max 6, 4/4 D2 veto, GO DEAD unconsumed — the reopening condition fires exactly. Reopening-class test: NG1 = announcement clock (FOMC instants + derivatives calendar), NG2 = announced-information (CPI/NFP macro prints + funding-settlement microtiming on the derivatives contract); the NG3 source is finalized issuer-contract logs (USDT Issue/Redeem, USDC Mint/Burn) — a flow/stock state observable, not a scheduled-information clock; CRYPTO-NG2's dead-class statement ('settlement mechanics') covers funding settlement times, not stablecoin issuance. Q2 NOVELTY HUNT: FAMILY_FAILURES.jsonl re-filtered = exactly 32 asset=crypto rows of 109 (V6..V16 19, V17 6, NG1 4, NG2 4 — matches critic's independent recount); grep across all 109 rows + full HYPOTHESIS_LEDGER for supply/issuance/mint/burn/stablecoin/usdt/usdc finds ZERO crypto issuance/supply observable — the only hits are symbol names (ADAUSDT/BTCUSDT), the forex pair USDCAD, and STOCKS-NG1's Form-4 'declared-plan supply persistence' (different asset, different observable). The settlement-layer float is genuinely unmeasured in the frozen ancestry. Reverse-causality concession adjudication: HONEST, not a disguised momentum/flow family — no causal claim is made anywhere (§1 'Direction is not assumed', §4 bans 'money entering crypto'/'buying pressure' outright), the claim is exclusively D2 incremental information over a declared shadow set at the frozen 0.20 bar with prewritten zero-budget death, and the exact disguise class the critic identified (census regime as relabelled price/vol state) is caught by the plan's X3 mandatory tape-fitted-issuance shadow, whose kill semantics are mechanical ('if it explains the anchor, the on-chain census adds nothing and dies'). Falsifiability: the design IS falsifiable as an incremental-information claim — X1-X5+F1 make every named escape route (dead ancestry, OI/funding relabel, tape-fitted proxy, clock geometry, invalid null, costs) a measured mandatory veto before any E cell; the family therefore earns a live slot rather than a prewritten kill, and a measured D2 kill is predeclared as the expected modal close (§6) without overselling. Q3 SCIENCE: C1-C11 are fail-closed and correctly ordered — the stocks_ng3 F3 fold-ordering class is fixed here (C10 freezes three chronological folds + exclusion rule textually in the P0 census commit BEFORE any D2; C5 freezes the minter netting rule in the same commit, measured full-window per the critic's FINDING-2 correction, never asserted); C4 pins Tron only_confirmed=true as MANDATORY with the USDC-primary fallback declared and 'never a silent stablecoin total'; C7 pins address+topic from self-computed keccak (4byte collisions documented); C9 runs the conservation identity with breaks as verdict rows. verdict_rationale: AUTHORIZED_WITH_FINDINGS, zero CRITICAL/HIGH. The plan's authority chain is correct from recorded bytes (P-19 verbatim + the CRYPTO-NG2 0/6 terminal row), the novelty claim survives an independent hunt of all 109 registry rows and the full ledger (no prior settlement-layer issuance/supply observable on any crypto family — the reopening is a new information class, not a relabel of the NG1 clock or NG2 macro-print envelopes), the reverse-causality concession is scientifically honest and made falsifiable by the X3 tape-fitted shadow and the mandatory X1-X5+F1 veto battery (so the family justifiably lives as a conditioning-only incremental-information design rather than a prewritten kill), the P0 gates are fail-closed with the fold/netting freeze correctly ordered at P0 (the exact defect class that killed the STOCKS-NG3 round-1 shape), the Tron and cross-check-source hazards the critic raised are absorbed as pinned gates, and every standing convention (budget 6/2, GO form, worktree, S1 seal, lock, shadow non-interference, registry-via-researchctl) is honored. The five findings are binding-text precision, not conclusion changes: X1's inventory definition must name the 29-shape panel triad (F1), the survivor terminal label and C10 miss mapping are missing (F2), the CC BY-NC cross-check leg needs its P-18 adjudication-or-drop rule (F3), doctor state debt must be disclosed at registration (F4), and the A7 launch key should be named (F5). All five are one-line-to-one-block remediations that do not alter any scientific or legal conclusion of the plan as written; per §12 the findings must be remediated and re-audited before registration.
